entry.name: allpass~
entry.description: Use the allpass~ object to filter an input with an allpass filter. The allpass filter has a flat magnitude response but a complex phase response, typically delaying sharp transients.

arguments.name: max-delay
arguments.description: The maximum delay time. Defaults to 10 ms if not specified.
